facts.business: Savera Industries Limited operates a hotel (Savera Hotel) in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, providing hospitality services including accommodation and food and beverage services.
key_risks: Economic instability, inflation, and recessions reducing consumer spending on travel and accommodation
Labor shortages and high employee turnover challenging service quality and operational efficiency
Rising costs of food, energy, wages, and maintenance increasing operating expenses and reducing profit margins
Intense competition from hotel chains, boutique properties, and alternative accommodation providers
Increasing competition from alternative accommodation providers
facts.related_party_note: There is no material significant related party transactions that may have potential conflict with the interest of the company at large. The policy for related party transactions has been posted on the Company's website. The related party transactions were recommended by the Audit Committee and placed before the Board for its approval.
